_comment: Example Computer Use configuration. Copy this file to .black-eclipse/computer.json and edit. This file is committed as a reference; the live copy at .black-eclipse/computer.json is gitignored. Env vars (HARNESS_COMPUTER_*) always override this file, which overrides the built-in defaults. Every value here is optional.

grounding._comment: Optional UI-TARS-class grounding endpoint (OpenAI-compatible). Empty url/model = unavailable; the ladder then uses AX, app adapters and OCR only.

memory._comment: A done that is a verified success yields a workflow candidate. auto_capture=false surfaces it for computer_remember; true also stores it in Eclipse-Memory (never screenshots, never typed text).
